gloss: leaving as is; deferment; keeping unchanged

definitions.gloss: leaving as is; keeping unchanged; maintaining the status quo
definitions.explanation: Keeping something at its current level or state without changing it. Most commonly used for interest rates, prices, taxes, or policies that are maintained rather than raised or lowered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{据|す}え{置|お}き⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The interest rate was left unchanged.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧{据|す}え{置|お}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: To continue selling at the same price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央銀行|ちゅうおうぎんこう}→中央銀行：10173_chuuouginkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政策金利|せいさくきんり}→政策金利：26656_seisakukinri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{据|す}え{置|お}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The central bank decided to keep the policy interest rate unchanged.

notes: From the verb ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}く→据え置く：18383_sueoku⟧ (to leave in place). Very common in financial and economic news. Common collocations: ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧{据|す}え{置|お}き (unchanged interest rate), ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧{据|す}え{置|お}き (price freeze), {据|す}え{置|お}き{期間|きかん} (grace period, deferment period — e.g., before loan repayment begins). Often appears as a compound modifier: {据|す}え{置|お}き{型|がた} (stationary type, as opposed to portable).
